exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: passes every requirement (rank 1; ranks 2 to 5 by reference)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: This is not a drop; it is P2's claim for its survivors. P2's requirement list leaves out four questions the owner marked 'for research (owner, 2026-09-28)' in Research.md at checkout c25aa863372d. V189 (line 749): the largest voltage between the ESC pack's negative at the balance lead and the IO board's ground, or else the isolation voltage. This decides whether an isoSPI transceiver or an isolator is part of the function. V190 (line 750): the largest current drawn from any one balance-lead pin, with the IO board powered and unpowered. The LTC6813 and ADBMS1818 draw their supply through V+ from the top of the stack unless the auxiliary supply takes it. V192 (line 752): the number of connectors and cells per connector. V193 (line 753): whether a jumper or adapter may set the cell count. No survivor has been checked against V189 or V190, so 'passes every requirement' is not established.
